Simplified metric variants to base forms (BLEU-1/2/3/4 → BLEU, ROUGE-L → ROUGE). Removed duplicate lowercase entries for precision/recall.
No LLM-based evaluation was used in this paper. The paper uses traditional automatic metrics and clinical efficacy metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on radiology report generation using cross-modal memory networks. Evaluation is comprehensive with both NLG metrics (BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE) and clinical efficacy metrics (precision, recall, F1) using CheXpert labeling. No human or LLM-based evaluation was conducted. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric names and removal of duplicates.
